thread:
camille: Heads-up — a handful of users reported losing product roles after Okta SSO login this morning. They can authenticate but RBAC falls back to 'guest'. :frowning_face:

raj: Confirming, saw 6 errors in the audit stream: role mapping returned empty for users that previously had 'editor'. Suspect JIT mapping issue. @marta can you check recent mapping changes?

marta: I pushed a mapping tweak yesterday to enforce `role` as a required SAML attribute when JIT provisioning creates accounts. Thought it was harmless, maybe we tightened validation too much. Looking now. :eyes:

okta-bot: automated-log: user_login uid=alice@acme.com result=success mapped_roles=[] assertion_attrs=[email, name, groups] saml_verified=true

camille: The failing users all have groups in the assertion but not an explicit `role` attribute. Previously we used `groups` -> role mapping in our app layer; my change tried to normalize to `role`. If mapping is missing we should fallback to existing group mapping, not guest.

raj: Can you paste the mapping snippet you deployed? Also include the SAML assertion example from the Okta logs if possible.

marta: Here's the mapping we added in Okta admin (JSON export):
```json
{ "mappings": [ { "target": "role", "source": "profile.role", "required": true }, { "target": "email", "source": "profile.email" } ], "jit": { "enabled": true } }
```

marta: And a sanitized SAML assertion sample we just captured: 
```xml
<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name="groups">
    <AttributeValue>product-editors</AttributeValue>
  </Attribute>
  <Attribute Name="email">alice@acme.com</Attribute>
</AttributeStatement>
```

raj: Aha — required:true for role means users without profile.role will get no mapped role. That should have been optional. This explains the empty mapped_roles.

camille: Two impacts: 1) immediate user-facing RBAC regressions; 2) audit trail currently shows successful logins but no evidence of a mapping fallback. We need to log mapping failures explicitly so we can alert on it.

sre-oncall: Are there any deploys tied to the mapping change? deploy-bot, what did yesterday's deploy include?

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-06-08T22:10Z by marta: okta-attr-normalize v1.2 -> rolled to prod; no DB migrations. Canary 10% -> 100% over 20m.

raj: Proposed immediate mitigation: rollback the required flag on Okta mapping to optional + patch app to treat missing role as "use groups mapping". Also add a warning-level audit log when mapping is missing. Anyone object?

marta: Rolling back mapping now, ETA 5m. Will also add an admin note.

okta-bot: automated-log: mapping_update by marta at 1768004800: role.required=false

camille: I'll open a quick PR for the app change to prefer existing groups->roles mapping and add a mapping-failure audit event. Add tests around missing attributes.

raj: Also let's check SAML signature verification errors — if KMS rotated recently we might see verification failures for some service providers. Can someone confirm KMS key version used to sign assertions?

marta: We rotated Okta signing key two weeks ago in KMS. No errors reported in Okta for signature validation. But I'll double-check our SP trust config.

camille: Postmortem items: 1) make Okta mapping changes gated behind a validation script that runs against recent assertions; 2) add explicit logs: mapping_attempt, mapping_success, mapping_fallback, mapping_failure; 3) expand alerting for sudden spike in mapping_failure rate.

sre-oncall: Logged incident INC-2026-06-08-OKTA-RBAC, priority P2. Assigned to @marta and @camille.

marta: Rollback complete. Users reporting access restored. Following up with a small change to mapping UI to remove 'required' toggle for role.

camille: Thanks. I'll land the app PR (small) and follow up with an eval to ensure no regression in 24h. :thumbsup:

raj: Great triage. Add to weekly security retro.

marta: FYI added a one-liner to the audit pipeline to include mapping_failure counts per 5m. Monitor at pager threshold.

camille: closing this thread once PR merged and metrics stable.
